## Overview

Texas data center growth has accelerated since 2024, driven by cheap land and an
independent grid run by ERCOT. Large-load interconnection requests passed 200 GW in 2026.

Key players include the Public Utility Commission of Texas and Governor Greg Abbott,
who signed SB 6 into law.
